points: \item Architected and deployed a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for enterprise-scale generative AI applications, improving document QA accuracy by ~20% and enabling high-quality synthetic data pipelines for model training.

\item Engineered a hybrid retrieval architecture combining dense embeddings (FAISS) with BM25 sparse search, achieving 35% improvement in retrieval relevance for large-scale LLM-driven synthetic data generation workflows.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation framework to assess faithfulness, relevance, and data quality across 500+ synthetic examples, ensuring production-grade reliability for fine-tuning and model optimization tasks.

\item Optimized LLM inference pipelines through batched query extraction and distributed computing, reducing API calls by ~80% and cutting training costs by 60% while maintaining scalable end-to-end data pipelines.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for data quality validation in generative AI workflows, reducing data errors by 25% and improving model performance through robust preprocessing and exploratory data analysis.

\item Fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA on domain-specific data with 4-bit quantization, gaining hands-on experience in parameter-efficient LLM training and state-of-the-art generative model architectures for production deployment.
